content: Commanded is the dominant Elixir CQRS/ES library. Its projections (via commanded-ecto-projections) subscribe to an event stream, apply each event using Ecto.Multi operations, and track a checkpoint (last seen event position) in the same transaction. Error/3 callback returns :retry, {:retry, delay, ctx}, :skip, or {:stop, reason}. Projections can be reset/rebuilt via before_reset/0 callback. start_from: :origin | :current | event_number controls initial subscription position. Consistency can be :eventual (default) or :strong (block until handlers finish). Missing: per-projection isolated migration histories, dead-letter parking with halt semantics, lag metrics, and generated query helpers.
